description: BEP - répertoire des bulles à verre (province de Namur) is a group of related datasets listed in Open Data Wallonie Bruxelles, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by BEP. Ceci est le répertoire des bulles à verres gérées par le BEP en province de Namur. The 4 datasets in this record: Andenne - Répertoire des bulles à verre; BEP - Répertoire des bulles à verre; BEP - Répertoire des bulles à verre (avec géolocalisation); Répertoire des bulles à verre (sans géolocalisation). Coverage: Province of Namur (Wallonia). The portal lists 4 related datasets of one publisher (copies, years or sister lists), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under Agriculture, Environnement. Its keywords are Environnement, Bulles. The portal shows 93 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The most recent modification among them is 2026-07-23 on the portal. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support waste collection, treatment and recycling network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-odwb-be-portal.
